401:t_1:60.en:
$$マツモト$$
「It is only by continuing to seek that people can carve out their own future with their own hands.」

401:t_1:61.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Is that why you set about human genome manipulation, which has been considered taboo?」

401:t_1:62.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Is that something to be condemned? I have information that the $$連邦政府$$ has already entered the testing stage of creating a humanity adapted to the environment.」

401:t_1:63.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Furthermore, the giant cryogenic sleep facility said to be under construction on the Moon could also be called a violation of the providence of humankind.」

401:t_1:64.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Unconfirmed information keeps coming, but...」

401:t_1:65.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Since this is a good opportunity, I would like all of you to know these facts as well.」

401:t_1:66.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「In contrast to the $$連邦政府$$, which is single-mindedly focused on restoring the Earth, where are you headed...」

401:t_1:68.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Our ultimate goal is to find a planet that can be settled and make it a second Earth.」

401:t_1:69.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Let me show all of you the results of that.」

401:t_1:70.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「W-wait, please! That wasn't in the plan...」

401:t_1:71.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...I apologize. This program is already being managed by the $$イボルバー$$.」

401:t_1:73.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Now then, to everyone in front of your monitors, allow me to show you some of the research results of the $$イボルバー$$.」

401:t_1:78.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Searching for a star that can be settled would take decades at the very least, even centuries.」

401:t_1:79.en:
$$マツモト$$
「There is only one way to break through this situation: applying biology in addition to mechanical engineering.」

401:t_1:80.en:
$$マツモト$$
「By evolving the human body itself, we can adapt to the vacuum of space, to astronomical distances, and to immense spans of time.」

401:t_1:81.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「This is... a desecration of life, isn't it...」

401:t_1:82.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Are you one of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives too?」

401:t_1:83.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「$$クロノ$$...?」

401:t_1:84.en:
$$マツモト$$
「All of humanity is being called on to evolve. That war made it a plain fact.」

401:t_1:85.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We are not heirs to the ideology of $$シャア・アズナブル$$. We seek evolution in a form different from the ideals he advocated.」

401:t_1:86.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...The symbiont is a wonderful invention. It can breathe the oxygen in the sea and withstand the water pressure of the deep. In time it will even adapt to the absolute-zero vacuum.」

401:t_1:87.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Nutrition is supplied through nanomachines and symbiosis. It resembles photosynthesis, but is far more efficient.」

401:t_1:88.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I have already undergone this surgery myself. In time I will become something more than human.」

401:t_1:89.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We $$イボルバー$$ await anyone with the will to live the future together.」

401:t_1:90.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Seize evolution with your own power, and let us carve out the future with our own hands.」

401:t_1:94.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...That is all of the information that can be played back.」

401:t_1:95.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... are humans who modified themselves...」

401:t_1:96.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Numerous contradictions found with the official information of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. Credibility is extremely low.」

401:t_1:97.en:
$$レド$$
「Then what was that data just now!? Who made it, and why!?」

401:t_1:98.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Hypothetical inference: possibility of information manipulation by the enemy.」

401:t_1:99.en:
$$レド$$
「The enemy? What enemy!? Weren't the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ an inferior life form!?」

401:t_1:100.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Remaining $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ detected. Annihilating.」

401:t_10:5.en:
$n
「That's because I followed your advice and fought with just the $$ジェニオン$$.」

401:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aren't the results of your special training starting to show little by little? You seemed to be fighting well enough.」

401:t_10:7.en:
$n
「It's driven home to me how much I'd been relying on Miss $$スズネ$$ until now.」

401:t_10:8.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ is a single-seater to begin with, so I have to be able to manage in that state.」

401:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, that's true. I'd gotten so used to it carrying two that I'd completely forgotten.」

401:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, $n, having fought it out in the $$ジェニオン$$, you produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

401:t_10:11.en:
$n
「I feel like I'm about to grasp something... That hope must be what produced the $$Ｚチップ$$.」

401:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... In that case, to keep the balance, shall I give you some despair as well?」

401:t_10:13.en:
$n
「I'll pass. I've got plenty of headaches lying around already.」

401:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Still, it's a relief that the strange intruder took $n's mind off things.)

401:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But the original $$ジェニオン$$, hmm... An intriguing thing to say.)

401:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now, $$エイミー$$... If you keep wearing such a gloomy face, $$レド$$ will be troubled when he comes back.」

401:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You came all the way out to the $$霧の海$$ because you're worried, didn't you?」

401:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand how you feel, $$エイミー$$, but $$レド$$ grew up in an environment different from everyone in the fleet.」

401:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just as you have your own sense of what's right, $$レド$$ has his.」

401:t_10:27.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You mean it's not a matter of which one of us is right?」

401:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly. And living by working such things out with each other is what the multiverse is all about.」

401:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since leaving the fleet, you must have been surprised many times, and run into things you couldn't accept or couldn't get used to, haven't you?」

401:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What you're feeling now is the same thing.」

401:t_10:32.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...I get it, $$ＡＧ$$. When $$レド$$ comes back, we'll think about what comes next together, the two of us.」

401:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're welcome. I, too, cannot bear to part with $$チェインバー#pilot$$, a fellow robot.」

401:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so, I'll have to leave the celebration for our ace pilot until another occasion.」

401:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, with your smile back, $$エイミー$$, let's get going! Let's give it our all again today...」

402:t_000:0.en:
$$レド$$
「At this depth, the influence of the Light Bugs seems to be small too...」

402:t_000:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Target organism, a.k.a. $$クジライカ$$: exoskeleton composition adapted to the environment, but genetically no difference from the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is recognized.」

402:t_000:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Judged to be the same species.」

402:t_000:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I knew it. ...The policy of annihilation is not wrong. It is necessary for the sake of the people of Earth as well.」

402:t_000:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Speculation. In light of the language analysis so far, it is thought that Earth humanity's definition of a survival strategy differs greatly from the Alliance's.」

402:t_000:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The answer to this query is not in the Alliance standard dictionary. However, it exists in the Earth language.」

402:t_000:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Coexistence and mutual prosperity.」
